name: qkd_seq_core_st_p-p1-COMMIT
purpose: KVE-2/SEQ 10-17, coordinator 0cx (3)/0db: the attention programme is the sole owner of attention RX. Successor of qkd_seq_core_static: CMD / Q events come from qkd_native_attention_programme request_valid/request_position and q_valid/q_beat (existing ports), Q data through qkd_seq_xd_sel. Bench vs qkd_seq_static on 36 link-slotted layers with the ACTUAL programme RTL: aq 1188 / kvn 72 / kc 72 per quadrant bit-identical, aq and kvn at the SAME edges, kc +1 edge (priced); mutants Q-beat swap / start late / xd_sel select FAIL.
